title: Archiving a tier with customers is blocked and lists them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders only.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Archive.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed with Customers 2.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers Archive.

Step 3:

  • A dialog opens instead of archiving.
  • It lists customer A with work orders and Part Sales and customer B with work orders only.
  • It has a Remove Customers link.
  • Its only button is Close, styled as a secondary button.
  • The dialog offers no move step and no "move all to another tier" action, while Close and Remove Customers show.
  • The title reads tier A's name followed by "Can't Be Archived Yet".
